text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 1: XGBoost on the plant's inputs alone beats the plant by about 3%; the other rungs add little. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling the 12 scored months. Dashed line: same as the plant. Metered farms A to F, 12 to 36 h, daylight.'
